tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pas lam 'bras gsung dus kyi gnad kyi zin bris rgyal lha khang blo gros seṅges mdzad pa rnams zhib tu bshad pa sbas pa mig 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i ngo bo chos kyi rje/ /theg gsum dam chos kun gyi chu gter mchog /sdom pa gsum pa'i tshogs kyi rgyan gcig pu/ /dpal ldan bla ma mus pa chen por 'dud/ /'dir chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa'i gsung 'gros zab mo gsung ngag rin po che'i skabs su gal che ba 'ga' zhig chos rje rgyal lha khang pa blo gros seṅges brjed pa'i 'jigs pa spang ba'i phyir brjed byang du bris pa'i man ngag gi gnad kyi gsung rgyun rnams 'dir dgod par bya'o/ /de yang lta khrid kyi lhan skyes gsum nyams su blang tshul dngos kyi sems 'dzin 'jug pa'i skabs su 'di gsungs/ sems glod la rang gi ngo bo ci 'dra zhig 'dug ltos zhes phyag chen pa rnams kyis sems 'tshol dang 'dra bar yun ci rigs pa 'tshol du 'jug gsal ba'am zung 'jug gang rung du thag chod chod bltar 'jug skabs 'dir go yul tsam gyis mi phan pas/ nang nas myong ba ma shar gyi bar du dris la sgom du 'jug gsal stong zung 'jug gsum po gang thag chod pa'i ngang la rtog med du 'jog rtog pa 'phro na gang 'phros kyi gsal stong du dran par byas la/ yang rtog med du 'jog gsal stong du dran pa lta bu'i rtog pa 'di kho rang rtog pa yin yang / ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu tshogs yin pas kho sngon la btang la/ dngos gzhi'i dus su kho yang rgyun bcad nas rtog med du 'jog dgos pa yin/ 'di shin tu gal che ste/ 'dir legs po zhig ma byung na lam 'bras pa'i sgom har 'gro nyan yod gsungs/ de yang zung 'jug tu thag bcad nas de'i ngang la rtog med du 'jog pa de dngos gzhi yin/

gsal ba la zhen na rtag mthar lhung / stong pa la zhen na chad mthar lhung / dbu ma bya ba mtha' thams cad dang bral ba la zer bas dbu ma'i sgom du 'gro ba la cir yang mi rtog par 'jog pa zhig dgos pa yin gsungs/ lhan skyes chos nyer bdun gyi nyams su blang ba'i dus su/ dgu tshan gsum po 'di la brten nas gegs sel la sogs pa go ba len rgyu mang po yod de/ dper na mo gdon gyi gnod pa byung na gsal ba la rtog med du 'jog pho gdon gyi gnod pa byung na stong pa la rtog med du 'jog klu gdon gyi gnod pa byung na zung 'jug la 'jog pa sogs kyi go rgyu yod gsungs/ snang ba sems su bsgrub pa sogs kyi skabs su/ snang ba dang rmi lam khyad par med pa lta bu'i dran pa dang / nges shes dang por bskyed nas/ de rjes dran rtog de yang rgyun bcad nas rtog med du 'jog pa la dngos gzhir byed dgos te/ 'di'i gnad ma go bar gzhan rnams kyis kyang lam 'bras dmigs bcas kyi sgom yin zer/ lam 'bras pa kho rang rnams kyang dmigs bcas gtso bor byed pa 'dra ste/ 'di pa'i dgongs pa ma yin/ dmigs bcas kyis dran rtog rgyu tshogs su byas nas dngos gzhi dmigs med rtog med ngang la 'jog pa yin/ spyir las dang po pa'i sgom la/ 'di sgom skyon med kyi khongs su gtogs/ 'di sgom ma yin pas sgom gyi khongs su ma gtogs zhes spu ris phyed pa byas nas/ sgom skyon med kyi thun thung pa zhig gal che/ sgom gyi rgyu tshogs su dran rtog stong dgos par bshad pas rtog pa'i rgyun de nyid sgom yin snyam pa byas na 'dzol 'gro gsungs/ gdon gyis slad pa'i dpe'i skabs su/ gdon gyi rigs kyis zin nas cal col smra ba la/ nang du rlung 'dzin pa las zab pa med/ khyed nyams mi lab na nga yang mi lab ces kha rog sdod par 'dug des na phyi rol ji bzhin nang / zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ snang ba sems su thag chod pa'i nges shes skye bar 'dug gsungs/

'di pa'i dmigs pa'i thun 'di rnams khrid kyi dkar chag gi grangs bzhin/ thun so so'i tshan pa sgom thun logs su byas la/ long yod na re re la yang thun ring du bsgom/ myur bar dgos na yang nyin zhag gcig la thun bzhi'am/ brgyad la sogs pa byas la thun re la thun dmigs re re'ang thun mgo thun mjug la thun dmigs rim bzhin bsgom pa sogs skabs dang bstun nas byed de nyams khrid du skyong ba'i lugs yin/ bshad pa tsam byed pa la ni nges pa med gsungs/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud kyi khrid kyi skabs su/ rtogs ma rtogs kyi dbang gis snang tshul la 'khor 'das tha dad du bzhag pa ma gtags rang bzhin tha dad med par thag bcad la nyams su blang gsungs/ dbang la 'khor 'das bsre ba'i skabs su/ sngon 'gro byas nas sems 'dzin gang yang rung ba la bzhag pa na/ rtog pa shar ba na rnam rtog 'di 'khor ba'i rgyu yin/ 'khor ba'i gnyen po ni dbang dang bskyed rdzogs yin pa las/ dbang gi sbyang bya sbyong byed khrid yig nas 'byung ba thams cad dran par byas la/ de thams cad kyang 'khor 'das dbyer med yin par thag bcad la rtog med du 'jog de lta bu'i 'brel btsal la nyams su blang tshul gzhan rnams la'ang shes dgos gsungs/ spyir 'khor 'das dbyer med bya ba/ zan gong gnyis bsres pa lta bus dngos po so so tha dad du yod pa gcig tu song ba la byed pa min/ 'khor ba kho rang gi gshis sam/ rang bzhin ye gdod ma nas spros pa'i mtshan ma thams cad dang bral bar gnas/ de rang bzhin gyi myang 'das yin pas 'khor 'das dbyer med zer ba yin/ rang bzhin gyi sangs rgyas kyang de la zer/ rang bzhin gyi zhes pa'i tshig 'di la nges pa zhig yod/ de ma sbyar bar sangs rgyas yin rang mi zer/ sems kyi chos nyid dam/ rang bzhin de la ye nas dri mas gos ma myong / des na rang bzhin rnam dag zer ba yin/ rang bzhin la ltos te lhun grub ces pa yang de la zer/

sangs rgyas kyi spangs pa chos sku 'dus ma byas su 'ong ba'i gnad kyang 'di yin/ nam mkha'i gshis la sprin gyis ma gos kyang / de la sprin gyi snang ba glo bur du 'byung ba dang 'dra bar/ sems kyi chos nyid ye nas dri mas dag kyang / sems can rnams kyis de ma rtogs pa'i dbang gis nyon mongs pa rnam rtog sna tshogs 'byung / de'i dbang gis 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/ 'khor ba'i gnyen por lam nyams su blangs pas dper na snam bu dkar po tshos kyi rkyen gyis tshos mar 'gyur ba bzhin du rnal 'byor lam pa'i sems kyi rgyun snga ma chos nyid ma rtogs par yod pa ste/ lam nyams su blangs pas chos nyid cung zad rtogs par 'gyur/ de 'dra'i skad cig snga ma la brten nas skad cig phyi ma phyi ma rnams chos nyid kyi rtogs pa je gsal dang je brtan la gyur te/ mthar stobs sogs sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gyi chos rnams thob/ de la yon tan la ltos te gnas gyur zer/ gnas gyur bya ba dri ma kho rang ye shes sam yon tan du song ba zhig la byed pa min/ rnal 'byor pa'i lam gyi sems skad cig snga ma snga ma la brten nas phyi ma phyi ma je bzang du song / dri ma rnams rim gyis bcom nas mthar dri ma thams cad spangs/ yon tan gyi tshogs mngon du gyur pa zhig la zer ba yin/ sangs rgyas dus na dri ma thams cad rtsa ba nas spangs pa zhig dgos pa yin mod gsungs/ spyir chos can med pa'i chos nyid mi srid/ chos nyid med pa'i chos can yang mi srid/ des na chos can ma rtogs par chos nyid mi rtogs/ chos nyid kyi ngo bo rgya che chung med kyang / lam gyi skabs su sgrib pa je srab ma song ba'i dbang gis chos nyid kyi rtog pa rgya je cher 'gro ba yin gsungs/ bskyed rim la 'khor 'das dbyer med bsre ba'i skabs su/ 'di pa'i lugs la bskyed rim stan thog gcig tu nyams su len pa bya ba yin/ de la dang por bskyed rim ji ltar gnas pa ltar gsal gdab/

de'i rang bzhin spros pa dang bral bar thag bcad nas spros med du 'jog sems rtog med du gnas pa de'i ngang nas ngag gi bzlas pa la sogs byed pa yin/ bskyed rim la brten nas du ba la sogs pa'i rtags 'char bar bshad pa yang / bskyed rim la sems zin nas rtog med du gnas pa'i mthu yin/ de 'dra'i bskyed rim sangs rgyas kyi rgyu min zer du mi rung / gal te zer na de skad zer mkhan gyi sbyor drug pa la'ang mtshungs par byas pas chog mod/ bskyed rim mchog thob pa'i thabs ma yin par bshad pa de rtog bsgom gyi skyed rim de mchog thob pa'am/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i dngos rgyu ma yin pa la dgongs/ rtog med la sems zin pa cung zad med na/ du ba sogs kyi rtags mthong ba mi 'byung / des na 'di 'dra'i rigs kyi dgongs pa thad ka thad kar shan legs par phyed pa byed dgos pa yin gsungs/ bskyed rim gyi ngang la bzhag pas rtog med du cham song ba na bskyed rim rdzogs rim du na 'phos pa bya ba de yin gsungs/ bskyed rim gtso bor byed pa'i gang zag yin na/ bskyed rim gyi khrid nas bshad pa bzhin sems 'dzin/ de la sems zin nas sems 'dzin lha so so'i dag pa/ de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa/ rang rig pa'i dag pa'i nyams rim pa bzhin skyes nas mi rtog par lhan song ba na de'i ngang la klod 'jog de la rdzogs rim ma bstan yang / bskyed rim gtso bor bstan pas rdzogs rim shugs la 'byung ba bya ba yin pas de kas chog spyir lam 'bras pa la bskyed rim gtso bor byed pa dang / rdzogs rim gtso bor byed pa'i lugs gnyis byung ba/ dang po bla ma tshogs sgom pa la sogs pa'i lugs yin/ khong pa'i lugs kyi thun bzhi ka la phyi nang gi bskyed rim gsal 'debs/ lam dus kyi dbang rgyas pa re re yang len/ de'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog rjes thob tu bzlas pa sogs byed/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis sgrib pa sbyong zhing tshogs rdzogs nas sangs rgya ba'i thabs khyad par can du bzhed pa yin/

phyi ma grub thob yon tan dpal la sogs pa'i lugs yin te/ sngon 'gro rnams byas nas rlung sbyor gyi ngang nas ting nge 'dzin bsgom/ sems mi gsal ba'am/ rlung gegs kyi rnam pa can byung na lus sbyong la 'jug lus cung zad dub/ rtog pa rags pa khegs pa'i tshe na sngar ltar lta ba skyong / de lta bu'i tshul gyis thun bzhir nyams su len/ bskyed rim dang / lam dus kyi dbang la sogs pa bar skabs su skabs dang bstun nas mdzad pa yin/ rlung gi rnal 'byor gyi skabs su/ spyir sangs rgyas kyis rgyud sde rnams su rlung sbyor gsungs pa rnams kyi dngos gzhi rdor bzlas dang / bum pa can gnyis yin/ man ngag rnams nas kyang tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod kyang 'di pa'i bdun po 'dir 'du zhing 'di rnams 'chun che zhing zab par yod pa yin gsungs/ rlung gi rtsol ba rngan dgas byin zhes pa/ phyir 'gro ba ring tsam rtsol ba byas pa na gzhan gnyis thung tsam 'ong bas yid kyis kyang de ltar bsam/ spyir rdor bzlas la 'byung 'jug gnas gsum po ma nor par yid gtod pa gal che/ thogs med kyi nyan sa las kyang / rlung brgya la sogs pa'i grangs byas nas sgom pa'i tshe/ grangs lan gcig 'jol na'ang / mgo nas bskyar te byed dgos par bshad/ sems mi rtog par song ba dang / du sogs kyi rtags snang shar nas 'byung 'jug gnas gsum la yid gtod pa ma byung yang / 'di sgom shor ba ma yin/ de'i ngang la bzhag pas chog gsungs/ dbang po'i sgo gzhan nas rlung gtong ba dang / ldog par nus zhes pa'i skabs su/ 'di'i yon tan nged kyi bla ma sron pa la chos dpal bzang po zer ba'i bla ma dam pas chos mang po nos pa de'o/ /yod de/ khong pa srod kyi dus su mchod pa gcig mdzad nas/ mi gzhan gyi bzhin/ ljog ljog dang med par lhan gyis gzims/ nam phyed tsam phyed yol tsam na ja gar mo sun 'ga' zhig gsol nas rlung sbyor la sogs pa'i thugs dam la zhugs pa yin/

skabs 'ga' srod la btung ba mang pa'am/ gzhan sku khams mi bde ba'i dbang gis spyan skyo ma sogs pas kheb pa na/ zhal dang shangs gnyis phyag gis bkag nas spyan nas rlung phyir bus pas spyan gnyis nas rlung si ri ri byung nas spyan 'dag thams cad sang dag par byed nus pa yod/ spyir bla ma sron pa dang / bla ma brag kha ba grags pa seng ge zer ba'i bla ma dam pas chos mang po nos pa de'o/ /gnyis thugs dam bzang la/ khong rnam pa gnyis min pa gzhan su med pa kho na 'dra ba'i phan tshun rbad chen po mdzad pa gnyis bdog bla ma brag kha ba'i gsung gis rlung bsgom pa bya ba mdung rtse la bro 'khrab/ gri kha la rta brgyug zer nas bya ba sla mo min gsungs nas bka' dam po mdzad/ su yin la rlung sbyor phog nas smyon pa mang po bzo pa 'dug gsungs nas zur za yang mdzad/ sron pa'i gsung gis/ da lta dal 'byor gyi lus thob/ gsang sngags kyi chos zab mo dang 'phrad dus rlung gi man ngag zab mo mi bsgom na/ mgo la ba ru skyes/ kha nas 'bu zer ba'i dus su bsgom pa e yin gsungs nas/ gzhan rnams la yang rlung sbyor gyi man ngag ston/ khong rang yang rlung sbyor gtso bor mdzad pa gcig bdog pa lags gsungs/ rgyu ba gsal ba'i tshe/ las bzhi sgrub pa'i skabs su/ sa rlung gsal ba'i tshe 'di dang 'di'i tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar gyur cig snyam pa'i 'phen pa btang nas de la rdor bzlas byas pas rgyas pa'i las 'grub/ de bzhin du gzhan gsum la'ang tshon par byas nas shes dgos gsungs/ spyir rdor bzlas 'di shin tu zab/ tho rangs 'di stong phrag re byas na 'phral gyi bar chad thams cad sel nus/ 'bum phrag gcig byas na tshe bsring bar nus/ 'chi ltas shar ba rnams la'ang 'di'i man ngag bstan nas 'bum phrag re tsam byed du bcug pas 'dis ltas mthong ba yong gi 'dug g.yas g.yon gyi rdor bzlas mang nyung du shor na/ dus tshod na khos gegs byed pa zhig yod pas/

g.yas su ji tsam byas pa'i tshod tsam g.yon du'ang byed pa la sogs grangs mnyam pa gcig dgos pa yin gsungs/ srog nas btang pa'i skyon gegs sel gyi skabs su/ ro stod gzer ba la lugs gnyis yod de/ yar 'tshangs nas gzer ba de byung na 'di'i gtong ba de byas pas thur 'gro/ yar mi 'tshang ba rgyang pa tsam gyis gzer ba yin na 'di byas pas phan pa zhig yod gsungs/ rlung ltas brtag pa la yang / g.yon pa'i rlung gi dus dang / khyad par nang 'jug gi dus su bzang ba la sogs pa'i brtag pa byed pa yin gsungs/ u rgyan pa rgya yul na yod dus khong sna g.yon nas rlung rgyu dus mi zhus grogs ma bcol ba la sogs pa la yang bshad pa byed/ g.yas nas rgyu ba na gzhan gyis bcol yang byed mi nyan par yod par 'dug gsungs/ kha nas sgra bcas su btang ba'i skabs su/ grang rlung 'di rnams la tshod zin pa dgos pa yod/ 'di byas pas sna sgo grang lhang byung na 'phro 'jog dgos/ de bzhin du pho bar 'ur sgra byung na'ang 'jog dgos/ thal na grang ba bskyed/ 'di 'chun can zhig yod pas tshad rims lta bu byung na'ang / ja tshwa rdor med pa tsam 'thung la 'di mang du byas pas zhi thub pa gcig yod do/ /bla ma sron pa'ang de bzhin mdzad/ dgang pa'i skabs su/ mchil ma sgra med du mid pa 'di dang po dka' mo zhig yod de/ rlung rngub pa'i dus nas mchil ma zhig lce'i rtsar bzhag la/ mgo bskyed pa dang rlung gnon pa dang mchil ma mid pa lhan cig tu byed gsungs goms nas de bzhin 'ong gsungs/ dgang pa gnyis pa'i skyon gegs sel gyi skabs su/ gang na sar rlung 'phul la/ de'i thad kyi lus drag tu bsgul bskyod byas pas nad de la phan pa yin gsungs/ dgang pa'i bogs 'don gyi nam mkha' ltar dpang gtod pa'i skabs su/ stod kyi cha kha yod kyi rnam pa lta bu sgom pa zhig dgos pa yin gsungs/ byi lha'i spyod pa ni/ gal te bsgyur ba'i ngang nas byed pa'i lugs kyang yod mod/

gzhan 'dug sa la rkang pa gnyis brkyangs/ de steng du lag pa gnyis brkyangs nas mdun du 'phul zhing / rgal tshigs kyi shed yod tshad rgyab tu 'phul ba yin gsungs/ spyir kha sbyor gyi skabs su/ rdor bzlas sogs snga ma snga ma la nyams rtags skyes pa'i rjes la/ phyi ma phyi ma'i bsgom pa'i yon tan skye ba yin no/ /rin po che tshogs bsgom pa la chos rje pas rdor bzlas phog te dbus su byon/ lo gsum song nas rjes dgang pa la sogs phyi ma rnams bstan pa yin/ khong la rdor bzlas kyi nyams rtags rnams bshad tshod bzhin byung ba yin pa 'dug gsungs/ bum pa can gyi rlung 'dzin lugs la/ steng rlung sngon la mnan nas 'og rlung 'then pa dang / 'og rlung sngon la 'then nas steng rlung gnon pa sogs lugs mang po yod kyang / 'di pa'i lugs kyi dang po 'og sgo cung zad bsdams la phyed 'then gcig byed/ de nas steng rlung khrid yig nas 'byung ba ltar mnan la/ 'og rlung drag tu 'then pa'i tshul gyis kha sbyar te/ 'og rlung gnyis kyi bar steng rlung mnan pa bcug nas 'dzin pa rlung skam kha ma bya ba yin/ kha sbyar gyi tshad bde mchog rgyud dang / rdo rje snying 'grel na/ pus mo la thal mo lan gsum bskor/ se gol lan gsum byas pa la tshad du byed/ de'i so drug la sogs byed pa zhig yod/ 'di pa'i lugs 'di ngag bgros brgyud pa cung ma dag pa zhig yin nam/ gang yin ngo mi shes pa zhig 'dug gsung bgros kyi rigs 'di yang ma dag pa mu mthud par 'gro ba zhig 'dug gsungs/ rlung sbyor 'di pa thams cad kyi rjes la lta ba skyong ba 'di gal che shos yin/ gsal ba rang so bzung bya ba/ sems kyi mtshan nyid gsal sing ba'i ngang la rtog med du 'jog pa yin/ lhug pa rang so bzung bya ba/ gsal bzhin du stong / stong bzhin gsal ba zung 'jug brjod bral gyi ngang la rtog med du 'jog pa yin/ 'di 'dra zhig gi nyams myong nang nas shar tsa na lta ba la nyams su myong ba bya ba de yong ba yin/

rlung sbyor gyi ngang la sems zin pa tsam 'di pa'i bsgom bya'i mthil so dang / lta ba nyams su myong par byas na mi yong bar bdog yang rtog pa 'phro na sngar bzhin rlung sbyor bsgom/ yang lta ba skyong bar byed pa yin/ 'di gal che shos yin pas skabs thams cad du shes dgos gsungs/ mar me gso ba'i skabs su/ srog rtsol gyi rlung gang rung gi lam btsal ba ni kha sbyar ma gtogs pa gzhan rnams gang rung gcig sngon la gtong ba yin/ srub shing 'khor lo'i skabs su/ gzhan khrid yig sbas don gsal ba bzhin yin la/ phra phra har har zhes pa'i skabs su me stag 'phro 'phro 'phros pas lus gang bar bsgom/ snying kha'i nyi zla kha sbyor gyi skabs su/ 'di'i rig pa gsal ba'i nyams khyad par can 'char te/ drung don yod pa'i gsung gis/ dpe cha lta ba la sogs pa rig pa mi gsal ba'i dus snying kha'i nyi zla kha sbyor bsgoms pas rig pa gsal sing yong bar 'dug gsungs/ rlung sbyor 'di dang dpa' bo 'ba' zhig pa gnyis steng rlung dag pa la gnad du bsnun pa yin/ 'og ma gsang gnas bde ba'i thig le 'og rlung la gnad du bsnun pa yin/ 'di gsum gsal ba mi rtog pa bde ba gsum rim pa bzhin sgrub byed yin gsungs/ mdzod spu'i skra dkar sa bon gyi skabs su/ lce rtsa 'gul zhes pa lce gyen la ldog ste rkan la sbyar nas 'jib pa'i tshul du byed pa'am/ so gnyis gshibs nas so gseb kyi mchil ma gzhibs nas med pa'i tshul du bya/ dmigs pa'i bsgom lugs mi gcig pa mang po yod/ mkhan chen pa'i gsung gis/ mar pa lho brag pas mi la ras pa la/ rgyud kyai rdo rje la brten nas gtum mo'i dmigs pa bstan/ gsang 'dus la brten nas sgyu lus rmi lam 'od gsal bar do rnams bstan/ gdan bzhi la brten nas 'pho ba bstan/ khong gis de rnams nyams su blangs pas yon tan phun sum tshogs pa 'khrungs/ khong gi slob brgyud rnams la chos drug tu byed pa dang /

chos gnyis su byed pa dang / chos bcur byed pa la sogs mang po byung / don gnad gcig gsungs te shin tu mad par 'dug gsungs/ gtum mo'i skabs 'dir lus gnad dam pa 'di shin tu gal che/ phyi lus kyi thabs 'gal drug po de byas dus nang dang / gsang ba'i thabs 'gal rang shugs kyis 'ong / de yang pus mo gnyis chu'i dkyil 'khor yin pa de gru mo gnyis me'i dkyil 'khor gyis mnan/ dpung pa gnyis chu/ lag mthil gnyis me'i dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin gyis mnan/ rang gi lus khong stong gi nang rgyu ma phus btab pa lta bu/ dmigs pa 'di stong ra'i dmigs pa yin pas zhag gsum tsam bsgom na bzang ngo / /me dmar skya la sogs dmigs pa lhag ma rnams gcig gi steng du gcig bsnan pa'i tshul gyis gsal btab nas bsgom pa yin/ grangs can dang grangs med spel dus grangs can gyi rlung sbyor gcig song / g.yas su rde'u gcig bzhag grangs med kyi rlung sbyor gcig song / g.yon du rde'u gcig bzhag de ltar spel ba nyi shu rtsa bzhis thun gyi tshad 'dzin/ 'khor lo'i dmigs pa'i skabs su/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad pa bsgom na legs/ me 'bar ba'i dmigs pa'i skabs su/ shug pa'i lo ma la me 'bar ba'i tshul du me lce thur du phra phra ba sgom gsungs/ 'di thams cad kyi rjes la lta ba skyong ba gal che bas thun zhabs thams cad du sems klod pa ste gang yang ched du mi bsgom par rang lugs su 'jog rtsol ba klod pa bya ba rlung 'dzin pa'i rtsol ba btang la rtsol med du bzhag pas/ zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin skyes pa de skyong ba yin/ gtum mos lam sbyangs pas lta ba rang byung gi ye shes gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin skye bas de la nyams len gtso bor byed pa yin/ des ma zin pa'i drod tsam byung ba la rgyu mtshan cher med/ gtum mo'i drod skyes nas byung ba na de dang lta ba gnyis bsres nas nyams su blangs pas drod kyi lta ba 'phel ba'i rgyu byed/

lta bas drod mi nyams pa'i rkyen byed pas bde drod kyi ting nge 'dzin phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba yin/ dang po ras thub pa'i drod yod kyang / phyis su song nas gos gang dro dro la jo bo 'ju dgos pa de lta ba dang bsre ma thub pa'i skyon yin/ lte bar gtum mo'i me 'bar ba bya ba'i gtum mo me mtshan nyid pa de bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis/ thur sel rlung dbu ma'i nang nas yar zhugs te lte ba man chad du slebs/ drod kyi rang bzhin du 'bar ba de yin gsungs/ gtum mo sgom pa'i skabs su/ drod cung zad cher song ba dang gos kyi cha rim gyis 'grib pa gal che/ de ma byas na rngul 'byung bas da gzod ras thub pa mi 'byung gsungs/ shes rab ye shes kyi lam sgom pa'i lam rgyas pa'i skabs su/ 'di'i skabs su thig le ma nyams pa'i ngang nas bde ba gang skyes kyi rang bzhin stong par ngo shes pa byas nas rtog med du skyong ba gal che shos yin gsungs/ zhags pa 'phangs pa la/ lag pa g.yon dang rkang pa g.yas dus gcig tu/ lag pa g.yas dang / rkang pa g.yon dus gcig tu 'phang bar byed/ bu chung gi spyod pa la rdo rjes skyil krung bcas la mgo bo mdun du sa la thug pa/ yang rgyab tu sa la thug pa/ de dus mgo bo dkrugs pa la sogs gsungs/ lam bsdus pa'i skabs su 'di man chad kyi phyag len la rigs mi gcig pa sna tshogs gcig 'dug 'o skol gyis kyang la la la zhus/ la la la dris pa yin te/ grub thob yon tan dpal gyi phyag len/ bla ma chen po'i slob ma yang yin/ bla ma sron pa'i slob ma yang yin pa cung chos sdings pa'i sgom chen zhig la dris pa'i lugs 'di 'chun che ba 'dug spyir hūm̐ la sogs pa'i 'dren 'di rnams la hūm̐ la sogs pa'i sgra mi gsal tsam byed pa dang / dang po shugs chung tsam byas la/ de nas shugs je cher gtong ba gal che ba zhig bdog yar drangs pa nas gsus khog gyen la sleb pa yong ba zhig dgos/

smad phyi la 'bu ru ru byung ba gnad du ma song ba yin/ hūm̐ gi 'dren gsum btud dbus su khor gcig de nas g.yas su khor gcig yang dbus su khor gcig g.yon du khor gcig yang dbus su khor gcig ste de ltar na khor lnga ste re re la khor gsum gsum ste bco lnga/ de bzhin du phyir 'bud pa dang po drag po ring po ring po gcig 'bring pa gcig 'bud pa thung ba gcig gsum gyi rjes la phyir thub tshad 'dzin pa snga ma ltar sbyar bas khor lnga ste bco lnga/ rngub pa ring ba dang / 'bring po gcig thung ba gcig gsum gyi rjes la nang du thub tshad 'dzin pa'i khor gcig de lta bus sngar ltar byas la khor lnga la so sor phye bas bco lnga ste bzhi bcu zhe lnga 'byung / 'di thig le nyams pa bsrung ba'i mchog yin/ 'chun che ba zhig bdog gsungs/ gung mdzub gzhib pa'i tshul mchu gnyis kyi bar so la reg tsam byas la/ mgo 'dar ba tsam du gzhib/ has hal gnyis po 'di rlung phyir 'phul nas thub tshad 'dzin pa'i lugs yin/ glang chen hing dang stag mo ngur ba la sogs kyi phyag len bla ma dam pa rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig sbas don gsal ba zhes bya ba/ 'dir bkod pa 'di grub thob yon dpal nas brgyud pa'i phyag len yin zhing 'chun che bar 'dug lus gnad tsog pu rkang pa brang nga sa la btsugs pa sogs kyi lus gnad 'di bla ma sron pa'i lugs yin zhing 'chun che bar 'dug pas byas pa yin/ seng ge rnam rol gyi phyag rgya byed pa'i tshe yang / sna bug mtheb mdzub kyi bar du bcar la rlung drag tu rngub cing mgo dkrug pa 'di gal che bar yod/ spyir yang thig le zin pa tsam gyis mi phan/ lus la khrems pa gal che/ zin yang lus la 'dren ma shes na nad du 'gyur ba'i skabs yod/ thig le 'phel bas mi phan/ bzhu ba gal che 'phel yang bzhu ba ma byung na thig le ma bzhu ba'i gegs bya ba zas mang du zas kyang lus zungs la mi phan/

sems mi bde/ lus sngo skam la 'gro ba sogs 'byung / de lta bu byung na byang sems bzhu ba'i man ngag rnams dgos shing / gzhan yang snab lud la sogs phyir mi 'dor ba de dag lus la byugs pa dang / sbrang sogs dang sbyar te nang du za ba la sogs byas pas kyang phan gsungs/ lus kyi rba rlabs kyi skabs su/ tshangs ra g.yas su 'degs dus pus mo g.yas pa mar 'then lag pa g.yon pa'i pus mo g.yon gnon/ de bzhin du g.yon la'ang shes par byed/ ngag gi rba rlabs kyi skabs su/ a'i gong gre ba nas 'don pa'i tshul du byed dgos te/ de la dang po 'dzer ba dang / 'chad pa byung yang goms nas gling bu'i skad lta bu 'byung ba yin/ ngag 'dren drag po'i skabs su de dang 'dra/ gzhan thams cad khrid yig na yod pa bzhin yin/ lam 'bras pa snga ma dag gi ngag 'dren zhib sgra med pa dang / drag po sgra dang bcas pa yin zhes bzhed/ 'dir bla ma dam pa rang gi khrid yig sbas don gsal ba/ bkod pa grub thob yon tan dpal ba'i lugs yin/ lag len bzang ba gcig 'dug gdangs de ltar byas pas rlung 'dar/ des lus 'dar/ des rtsa 'dar/ des thig le 'dar zhing 'phel bas gyen la 'gro ba'i dgos pa yod/ 'di byang sems nyams pa lta bu'i gegs byung ba'i tshe byed cing / de yang tshod zin par byed dgos/ stod 'tshangs yod pa'i rigs kyis 'di byed mi nyan gsungs/ rin po che tshogs pa nas brgyud pa'i lugs 'di la ngag 'dren 'di rnams gang rung rung du byas pas gsang sgrogs su 'gro bar 'dug zer nas gzhan pas phyis phyag len cung ngan pa byung / sems kyi rba rlabs kyi dmigs pa 'di rnams da lta mngon du ma gyur pa'i tshe rtog pas bsgom pa'i rnam bzhag dbang bzhi pa'i lam gyi lugs kyi nus pa chung ba 'dra zhig 'dug ste/ mngon du gyur pa'i tshe ji lta ba bzhin byed nus pa de'i rten 'brel sgrig pa'i dgos pa yod gsungs/

zhes gzhung ji lta ba bzhin dkri ba'i khrid yig gi skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i gnad kyi gsung bgros/ chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa'i zhal nas ji ltar byung ba bzhin/ chos rje rgyal lha khang / blo gros seṅges zin bris su mdzad pa rnams zhib tu bshad pa sbas pa mig 'byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can dang / 'gro ba'i mgon po bsod nams rgyal mtshan de nyid kyi rnam par sprul pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa'i rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan te 'brel tshad don ldan gyi bla ma du mas rjes su bzung zhing / stobs kyi mgon po bi ru pa'i man ngag gsung ngag rin po che'i chos skor la las 'phro cung zad sad pa'i rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya ba sa skya pa'i rjes 'jug rig 'dzin skal ba bzang po can de nyid kyis bod kyi rdo rje gdan gyi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba 'dis man ngag zab mo nyams len mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 12 a myes zhabs/ bla ma dam pas lam 'bras gsung dus rgyal blo gros seṅges zin bris mdzad pa rnams zhib tu bshad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 13
